discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed. Tests now import and call the real `getWindowsConsoleEncoding()` function instead of asserting against an inline literal.

Fixed in 85ba54c1e8. When a Skip names a row that sits before the cursor (one New set already paged past), the cursor now moves back by one. Only the skipped row leaves the pool, and the rows on screen stay put. A test pins your sequence: New set, then a late Skip for Verify, leaves Review/Wrap up/Next step in view, and Undo skip brings Verify back to the front. I also fuzzed 4,000 random verb sequences offline against "a skip hides only its row, more drops only the last row, Undo skip brings its row into view". The fuzzer finds this bug without the fix and finds nothing with it.

Added a real-SDK case that aborts the request from inside the retry notice, while the wait is pending: the stream ends well under the backoff delay, no second fetch happens, no text is emitted, and no `sdk.error` is captured for the cancellation.
Fixed in 3e546f0: stage, unstage, and discard run with --literal-pathspecs. Test stages and discards a file literally named draft*.txt next to draft1.txt and checks the sibling survives.

Fixed in ac405ed: gitlink entries (mode 160000) are detected from the index/tree before reading anything, and previewed the way git diff shows them: 'Subproject commit <sha>' on each side (the working side is the submodule's checked-out HEAD). Covered for commit previews and working-tree previews with a real submodule in the test repo.

Fixed in ac405ed: the SSH listing now runs a small POSIX sh script (folder passed as a positional argument) whose [ -d ] test follows symlinks, so a link to a folder gets the trailing slash and expands like locally; dotfiles and dangling links are still listed. The script is executed for real in project-files.test.ts against a temp folder with a linked folder and a dangling link.

Addressed in the follow-up commit: the new `charges a flat ESTIMATED_TOKENS_PER_IMAGE per image` test asserts the delta for one image is `ESTIMATED_TOKENS_PER_IMAGE` plus the JSON overhead and that payload length leaves the estimate unchanged, with the same payload-length check added to the `createTokenEstimator` test. Removing the per-image term now fails the suite.

Fixed in a626fea957. CLINE_REMOTE_HELPER_DIRECTORY is checked before host-runtime probes and the packaged installer branch. Added an offline regression test with packaged installer variables set and a local cross-target helper; it returns the helper without invoking the installer. All 6 helper selection tests pass.

Right, fixed in 0d218eca2. The test now sets the variable with `vi.stubEnv` and restores it with `vi.unstubAllEnvs()`, which deletes a variable that was unset before. The same commit also makes the wizard parse each header with the parser `--yes` uses.

The new `transcription.openai.wire.test.ts` drives `transcribeAudio` with an `openai-native` config through the real adapter and a stubbed fetch, and asserts the request reaches `/v1/audio/transcriptions` and the transcript comes back. It fails if the stubbed fetch isn't wired through.
